Author: Duskbound
Name: Yanbot PF Ping
Punchline: Pings you in Discord when your Party Finder listing fills up.
Description: Zero-configuration companion plugin for the Duskbound Discord bot. While you're AFK, if your cross-world party fills to 8/8 because someone else joined, it tells the bot - which pings you in a Discord channel if you've linked your character with /register. Nothing to set up: just install it.
